surfaces.notes: Built (lane ENTAPI-L16D, T-713): driver internal/vendorapi/aws QDeveloperEvents, the first row of the egress seam's SigV4 signing table (us-east-1, signing name cloudtrail) and a reviewed POST row (body kind cloudtrail_lookup, content type application/x-amz-json-1.1 and X-Amz-Target, both signed). Conformance against the vendormock mock (SigV4 verified by the mock, NextToken in the body). Landed as vendor audit events in namespace aws.cloudtrail: EventId, EventName as a snake-case action, Username as the actor (aws_username), the first resource as the target, read_only and resource type as detail. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. assumption_tested: the response is synthesized from the reference's syntax (no example response); integer EventTime seconds are Inferred (the AWS JSON protocol may send a fraction, which the driver accepts). Secret class reviewed: may_return_secret because CloudTrailEvent carries request parameters; closed DTO, never decoded. One Region per row; eu-central-1 (the other Q Developer profile Region) would be its own row. Kiro's own event names are still AwaitingReference (aws.cloudtrail.kiro_event_mapping).
